cash_usd.description: Cash lane. Written by survival-cash. Off-host continuity must not set this.

lane.description: Cash lane label. Off-host continuity must not set this.

when.description: Cash-lane stamp. Older files may use a Z suffix. Off-host does not rewrite it. New off-host stamps use a Europe/Zagreb numeric offset.

volume_used_pct.description: Disk percent read by galion-desk. Off-host continuity must not set this.

offhost_enabled.description: True after HERMES_OFFHOST=1 has heartbeated into this file. Absent means off.

last_heartbeat.description: Europe/Zagreb RFC 3339 with a numeric offset.

external_state_uri.description: Public secondary path or URI. Query, fragment, and userinfo are removed. No token.

last_export_ok.description: Whether the last primary heartbeat reached the secondary store. Null when no store is configured or the writer is a standby.
